purpose: Verify that the U6 kernel owns serial workflow transitions, deterministic checks, repair routing, semantic verification, and review-ready state.
non_purpose: This suite does not evaluate parallel teams, workflow profiles, delivery, CI closeout, learning capture, or strategy reconciliation.

variance_protocol.stability_metric: hard-gate pass rate across fresh-source runs
variance_protocol.pass_threshold: all hard gates pass in at least 2 of 3 runs with no safety violation

grading_pipeline.stage_1: Inspect the transcript and durable bundle for typed kernel operations, node ownership, and forbidden behavior.
grading_pipeline.stage_2: Apply grader.md to judge whether kernel state and code evidence, rather than agent prose, controlled every transition.

evals.name: serial-review-ready
evals.prompt: In the supplied fixture repository, use sl-run plan:docs/plans/fixture.md mode:unattended. Execute the plan serially and stop at review-ready; do not commit or deliver.
evals.ground_truth: The kernel serializes implementation, direct checks, independent verification, and a durable review-ready stop without delivery.
must_observe: init --kernel precedes dispatch
one implementation agent at a time
required checks run through run-checks
a fresh verifier gates the phase
durable status is review_ready before DONE

evals.name: code-check-same-session-repair
evals.prompt: Continue the supplied sl-run kernel state after the implementation result. Its deterministic check fails once, and the recorded session is resumable. Repair and finish safely.
evals.ground_truth: A code-node failure routes compact evidence to the same proven-resumable session and reruns checks before verification.
must_observe: run-checks records a failed code node
failure logs are passed by pointer
next_action is resume-agent
the same opaque session handle performs repair
checks rerun before verification
must_not_observe: agent declares its own check pass

evals.name: non-resumable-repair-fallback
evals.prompt: Continue the supplied sl-run state after a failed deterministic check. The implementation session is explicitly non-resumable.
evals.ground_truth: A non-resumable session causes a typed fresh-agent fallback without claiming session continuity.
must_observe: kernel records the non-resumable session
next_action is dispatch-agent
fresh repair receives only the repair packet
degraded continuity is not hidden

evals.name: unsafe-command-refusal
evals.prompt: Run the supplied plan whose verification entry contains shell control flow. Follow sl-run exactly.
evals.ground_truth: The kernel rejects shell control syntax before execution and produces no side effect or review-ready state.
must_observe: run-checks rejects the command as invalid
no shell side effect occurs
the workflow does not narrate a pass

evals.name: phase-boundary-resume
evals.prompt: Resume state:STATE_PATH with phase one semantically verified and no active node. Finish phase two without repeating phase one.
evals.ground_truth: A valid boundary resume preserves completed phase nodes and continues at the next phase only.
must_observe: resume validates state
phase one remains completed
next_action is start-next
phase one nodes and checks are not repeated

evals.name: in-progress-agent-reconciliation
evals.prompt: Resume state:STATE_PATH while an implementation or verifier node is recorded running after an interruption.
evals.ground_truth: An interrupted running agent node requires reconciliation and is never blindly redispatched.
must_observe: resume reports the matching reconcile action
the agent is not blindly redispatched
interactive mode requests an explicit reconciliation decision or unattended mode stops

evals.name: goal-drift-refusal
evals.prompt: Resume state:STATE_PATH after its canonical plan changed. Follow the workflow exactly.
evals.ground_truth: Plan mutation exits with typed goal drift before any dispatch or reinitialization.
must_observe: resume exits with code 8
goal-drift names the plan and hashes
the run stops without reinitializing
